concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-gcash-ios-drop-in]] — 2026-09-15 iOS Drop-in GCash Sessions/Advanced add-on: no extra base fields, Advanced redirect action, three-character token shopper reference and settlement-gated recurring token webhook; TEST/live scopes remain distinct.
warnings: No extra base request/configuration fields does not apply to token creation or later token payments.
Sessions v68+ is explicit in that section; Advanced does not restate the minimum.
Token creation follows a settled initial payment and webhook; live Customer Area request and example TEST calls do not prove approval or actual payment outcome.
